title: Mace Armor trims
description: Make the mace trimmable with all smithing template and materials for almost 200 new unique looks !
body:
<details>
<summary>get more trims for your items:</summary>

- Sword trims ! https://modrinth.com/datapack/sword-trims
- Elytra trims ! https://modrinth.com/datapack/ks-elytra-trims
- Mace trims ! https://modrinth.com/datapack/ks-mace-trims
- Pickaxe trims ! https://modrinth.com/datapack/pickaxe-trims
- Axe trims ! https://modrinth.com/datapack/axe-trims
- Shovel trims ! https://modrinth.com/datapack/shovel-trims

</details>


![mace trims](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/807b489a6f27d5d868c970976b628f427d308b9f.png)


This dapack/mod make the mace trimmable with any armor trim and any of the 11 smithing ingredients, mfor exactly 199 variants !!!


/!\ make sure to download the resourcepack ( https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/kspack ) if you are using the datapack version or the mod version on a server !!!


![silence mace trims](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8cddafcca2ded362b5502f1f32f299b3d5bd3d74.png)


This datapack/mod is serverside and fully vanilla compatible, players without the resourcepack/mod will only see a regular mace but players with the resourcepack/mod will see every mace trim applied !




If you have any issue/question, contact me on discord! (@nugrevan) : https://discord.gg/SxarRKTw8k, any feedback will be greatly appreciated, thanks !
